meta.title: 注塑 DFM 设计规范

panels.reason_zh: 缩痕来自局部收缩量超过体积补偿。筋比壁厚收缩得快，筋过厚时表面先冷、周围壁料补缩不足，表面被拉凹；圆角过小则玻纤在转角堆积、基体被割断。
panels.reason_en: Sink marks appear where local shrinkage exceeds what the surrounding volume can feed. A rib shrinks faster than the wall; a tight radius traps glass fibre and cuts the matrix.
panels.failure_zh: 筋过厚 → 表面缩痕   ·   R 过小 → 纤维堆积
panels.failure_en: A thick rib sinks the surface  ·  a tight radius packs fibre

points_en: ribs in a grid or radial pattern
bring the wall back to 2-3 mm
panels.reason_zh: 实心厚壁件冷却时间长于薄壁件，先冷却区收缩量大、后冷却区被拉薄，残余应力直接变成翘曲。掏空把壁厚拉回均匀区间。
panels.reason_en: A solid block cools far slower than a thin wall, so the early-shrinking region pulls against the still-soft region and the residual stress shows up as warp.
panels.failure_zh: 实心厚壁 → 缩痕与翘曲
panels.failure_en: A solid thick wall brings sink marks and warp

points_zh: 壁厚变化处用圆角或斜面过渡
禁止厚壁直接叠在薄壁上
points_en: radius or chamfer every thickness step
never stack a boss straight onto a thin wall
panels.reason_zh: 突变壁厚在凝固时形成两个收缩速率不同的区域，交界处应力集中，最先出现缩痕与开裂。用圆角把收缩速率的台阶抹平，是成本最低、也最容易被忽略的一条。
panels.reason_en: An abrupt step creates two zones with different solidification rates; the boundary takes the stress and is where the sink mark appears first.
panels.failure_zh: 直角台阶 → 缩痕与开裂
panels.failure_en: A square step brings sink marks and cracks
